decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. SUDS PRO FORMA  BNG STRATEGY   FIRE STATEMENT   BNG NET GAIN POST DEVELOPMENT PLAN   BNG NET GAIN PRE DEVELOPMENT PLAN   X03X01PL003 (PROPOSED ELEVATION)PL003 (PROPOSED ROOF PLANS, SECTION AA AND LOCATION, BLOCK PLAN)PL002 REVISION AX02DESIGN + ACCESS STATEMENTHIGHWAY SAFETY IMPACT FORMSTATEMENT OF PURPOSEReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) and the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, or any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting those Orders, the development hereby approved shall be used only for purposes falling within Use Class C2 (children's care home), and for no other purpose.Reason: To ensure that the use of the premises remains appropriate to the character of the area and the assessment of the application, and to prevent the introduction of alternative uses that could give rise to unacceptable impacts on amenity, traffic or the local environment without further consideration by the Local Planning Authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be occupied by no more than 5 residents and 6 members of staff (excluding ad hoc visiting specialists/ therapists) at any one time.Reason: To minimize the impact of the development on the occupiers of neighbouring properties and to ensure that car parking provision complies with the Council's adopted standards.

The development shall not commence until details of source control SuDS has been submitted and approved by the Local Authority. Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. The developer should use the SuDS Proforma for minor developers found on our webpage https://www.enfield.gov.uk/services/planning/sustainable-drainage-systems to assist them through our requirements.REASON: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF.

Prior to occupation, the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved secure cycle store details as set out in drawing (ref: PL002 Revision A). The secure cycle store shall be retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking in accordance with Policy T6.1 of the London Plan (2021), the Council's adopted standards and London Cycling Design Standards Chapter 8.

Prior to occupation, the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved refuse store details as set out in drawing (ref: PL002 Revision A). The refuse store shall be retained and maintained as such for the lifetime of the development.Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of household refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.
